name: seo-geo-audit
summary: Audit generative-search and AI Overview readiness with source-tier labels and no unsupported visibility claims.
inputs: domain, pages, entities, market, language, audience, query set, date, and scope
approved content, SERP, schema, entity, Brand, local, and first-party evidence
external_reads: approved external search, AI, provider, page, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live external search, AI, provider, or page reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: content, schema, CMS, code, publishing, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: every claim has source tier, source/date, confidence, and limitation
vendor studies and heuristics remain distinct from confirmed observations
no model output, entity, citation, or visibility result is fabricated
no AI visibility, citation, traffic, ranking, or agent-success guarantee is made
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable sources produced no fabricated AI or citation evidence
verify no content, schema, CMS, code, publishing, provider, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
